key_findings: The program enrolls 135 students in total across three schools: SCH-001 (60), SCH-002 (45), SCH-003 (30).
The program operates 14 tutoring groups: 6 at SCH-001, 5 at SCH-002, and 3 at SCH-003.
Eight students (~5.9% of enrollees) have not yet been assigned to a tutoring group as of the reporting snapshot.
limitations: Student counts reflect enrollment as of the snapshot date; students who withdrew before that date are excluded.
Group counts describe the current active roster and do not reflect any mid-quarter reassignments.
